en.sayed-ali-raza: The Prophet of Allāh — peace and blessing of Allāh be upon him and his descendants — said:
“The belief of a person cannot be firm unless his heart is firm, and his heart cannot be firm unless his tongue is firm.”

So whoever of you can manage to meet Allāh, the Sublime, in such a position that his hands are unsmeared with the blood of Muslims and their property and his tongue is safe from exposing them, he should do so.
